{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows low positivity (e.g., 0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude when recent history shows strong downward momentum (e.g., 3+ consecutive drops) and model fails to reflect mean reversion.",
    "Increase forecast if sentiment history includes 0.33–0.50 and model underestimates upward potential, especially after recent lows.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is significantly higher than forecast 3–5 days prior, adjust current forecast upward by 5–10%.",
    "Cap forecasts above 75.00 when sentiment is neutral or negative and historical volatility is high.",
    "If model shows overshoot after a spike (forecast > true outcome + 10%), reduce by 10–20% to avoid overreaction.",
    "When sentiment history includes 0.67, model should be more conservative — reduce forecast by 3–5% to avoid overconfidence.",
    "For 30-day forecasts, if true outcome deviates >15% from model, apply a smoothing filter to reduce volatility in next forecast."
  ]
}
